verdict.rationale: Base44's own docs describe a template gallery of community-made templates that users choose and customize instead of starting from a blank prompt. Creators can also publish public templates, and the CLI create command offers templates to start from. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the template and community-project experience, details on gallery depth and remixing of community projects.

support.subject: As a founder, I can start from a template or community project instead of a blank prompt

citations.quote: Browse a wide range of ready-made templates created by talented creators in the community.
Just choose a template and customize it to fit your needs.
You can also publish your own public templates for others to use
You can choose from available templates to get started quickly.
